verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Mem0 Open Source is the same memory engine as the Platform, running on your own infrastructure with full control of the stack and data. They also describe a self-hosted Docker stack that bundles the REST API, a dashboard, per-user API keys and a request audit log, with a setup guide. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, and no evidence of the source repository or license terms.
